items.source: System Informer has partnered with Hybrid-Analysis to provide automatic reputation analysis for processes, loaded modules, and services.
items.translation: System Informer 与 Hybrid-Analysis 合作，为进程、已加载模块和服务提供自动信誉分析。
与 Hybrid-Analysis 共享的内容

items.source: •  SHA-256 hashes of scanned images, for reputation lookup
items.translation: •  扫描文件的 SHA-256 哈希，用于信誉查询

items.source: •  Files unknown to Hybrid-Analysis are uploaded for full analysis
items.translation: •  Hybrid-Analysis 未知的文件会被上传进行完整分析

items.source: Results appear in the Hybrid-Analysis column. To show it, right-click any column header and select ""Choose columns..."".
